questions.text: What's a favorite memory of ours from this year? Write a few sentences.
questions.authorText: Mine is our rainy walk where we shared an umbrella and got hot chocolate after.

questions.text: Tell me something kind you did for yourself this week.
questions.authorText: I actually took a real lunch break on Tuesday and read a chapter of my book.

questions.text: What are you looking forward to next weekend?
questions.authorText: A slow morning with croissants and a long phone call with you.
